$comment: Exponential Desktop's factory sidebar (#EDE-44, #EDE-65): the IDE's icon rail for good, a 56 px top layer surface on the left edge, black like the IDE's (the IDE's ground: no Sidebar fill), standing on the taskbar (the taskbar spans the bottom edge and holds the start, chat and new-issue buttons). No 272 px column, no rail toggle, no workspaces, search, inbox, Needs you or team switcher here (the start menu holds the switcher and Settings). It lists only the chats, flattened, most recent first: /shell/chats [{id, title, glyph}] from uicore-model's chatRows (packages/uicore/fixtures/shell.json `chats`): the current team's or Local desktop's root sessions, each the agent's mark as in the IDE's rail (`agent:claude`, `agent:codex`, with its dot as `ide:badge:dot:<tone>|<glyph>`: amber needs you, green busy, primary unread); a press opens the chat (ede_chat {sessionId}: eDE's chat on that session, on a Local desktop and on a team alike; the Exponential app's session (exponential://session/<id>) only when the team's chat cannot open it). The IDE mounts this document too (#EXP-1725): its rail and column are the shared nodes (the header with the switcher, search and new, the ide_* sections it fills from /shell/ide (packages/uicore/fixtures/ide-sidebar.json; ide_prs = #EXP-1616's Pull requests tree of the team's Exponential repositories, a List{divided:false} like the other sections, the IDE fills with Rows {depth, identifier #n, title, subtitle head → base} from /shell/ide/prs (a Row's depth never binds: the tree guides are computed from its siblings), a press opening the repo's page; it hides while /shell/ide/prs is empty), and the corner: the person's Assistant with the Exponential mark, the Computer button (Terminal, Files, Source control, Version history, the trunk's failure badge) and Settings, #EXP-1741); eDE prunes those it does not draw (the header, ide_nav, the corner) and never feeds /shell/ide, and the IDE prunes `chats`. #EXP-1832 (domain-contract sidebar-folders.json, genUI list-reorder.json): ide_boards_list, ide_agents_list and ide_apps_list are reorderable Lists (maxDepth 2, template key id) over the folder-aware rows of /shell/ide (ide-sidebar.json FOLDERS: kind, depth, group, open, meta, foldIcon, editing); each item is an ide_<section>_node Box showing ONE of: the folder Row (a right-click Menu: Rename, Ungroup; a press folds it: its fold chevron, the item count while folded), the folder's name Input in place (editing: Enter or leaving it saves, Esc keeps the name, as on the web), the item Row, or the item Row one level in (depth 1). Host events: ide_move {section} with the List's move {id, before|after|into} as payload; ide_folder {action: fold | save | leave, section, id} (save carries the Input's {value}; leave = its blur, the host reads the field), and the folder Menu's ide_folder {section, id} with {value: rename | ungroup}. The host functions: ede_chat, ede_start_menu, ede_launch, ede_switcher.
